composer.vocabularyRequired: Enter one or more English words or phrases after /vocabulary.
composer.phraseHint: One phrase per line; batch input is supported. Spaces and punctuation inside a phrase are kept.
composer.synonymRequired: Enter English words after /synonym, separated by commas.
composer.synonymHint: Example: /synonym adequate, decent. Previously saved words are skipped.

composer.explorePhraseHint: Just send it to generate 10 common English phrases; the last 7 rounds are never repeated.
composer.exploreVocabularyInvalid: /explore-vocabulary takes no arguments. Send it as is.
composer.exploreVocabularyHint: Just send it to generate 10 common English words with meanings and examples; the last 7 rounds are never repeated.
